# Design Brief Template

Use this template when a Work Block includes frontend design, showcase demo
work, visual redesign, source-design porting, or design-skill selection.

The Design Brief is an implementation input. It does not approve production
scope by itself and does not replace Product, Architecture, Review, or
Verification gates.

## Meta

- Work Block:
- Project/demo:
- Surface/routes:
- Source reference:
- Fidelity mode: [exact-port | inspired-adaptation | redesign | greenfield]
- Owner-approved design reference:
- Target audience:
- Business goal:

## Design Skill Stack

- Base design skill:
- Style/taste skill:
- Component/system skill:
- Motion/source-tool skill:
- Rejected skills:
  - [skill]: [why rejected]
- Collision guard:
  - [what must not be mixed]

Use one dominant aesthetic. Do not stack multiple taste skills unless the
Design Analyst explains a clear hierarchy and rejects conflicting patterns.
